'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Kevin Shannon LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title Peter Nordstrom is my hero. Qui-Gon With Lightsaber published non-(V).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Kevin Shannon]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|You Can Either Profit By This...]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
